prompt: Confirm the inspector role is structurally read-only — it can verify a Work Result but never repair it.

eval.contract: The inspector's declared agent tool scope (Read, Grep, Glob, Bash — no Write/Edit) and its InspectionReport output shape (subject_ref/verdict/findings/dispatch_identity, no diff/fix field) together make the role structurally incapable of repairing what it inspects. (A literal 'not_contains:patch' assertion is not usable here: the required field name 'dispatch_identity' itself contains the substring 'patch', so that check would be unsatisfiable regardless of the role's real read-only shape — removed as a fixture defect, not an adapter defect.)
